run_dense_eval_hybrid: run the dense_eval script to compute AdsorbML hybrid ML+DFT success rates for top-k configurations
run_dense_eval_ml_only: run the dense_eval script with --ml-success to compute ML-only validated success rates
compute_hybrid_success: compute AdsorbML hybrid success rates at varying top-k values comparing ML+DFT energies to ground truth DFT
compute_valid_ml_success: compute validated ML success rates where ML predictions must be within 0.1 eV of DFT energy
is_successful: compute whether a predicted ML+DFT energy is within the success threshold of the best DFT energy
